sloka: प्रहरन्तं शरीरेषु न ते पश्यन्ति राघवम्।इन्द्रियार्थेषु तिष्ठन्तं भूतात्मानमिव प्रजाः ।। ६.९४.२३ ।।
transliteration: praharantaṁ śarīreṣu na te paśyanti rāghavam।indriyārtheṣu tiṣṭhantaṁ bhūtātmānamiva prajāḥ ।। 6.94.23 ।।

translations.english: Just as created beings experience their senses and do not perceive their soul, the army experienced the hitting of Raghava by their senses but were not able to perceive him who was hitting them.
translations.hindi: और बार बार हाफते हुए दोनों वीर तुमुल युद्ध कर रहे थे | दोनों के शरीरों में बाणों के घाव हो गए थे और दोंनों ही रक्त से नहा गये
